options.name: extra_properties
options.description: Additional properties to retrieve (appended to the default ones). Note that all property names are converted to lower-case.

options.name: unitname
options.description: List of unit names to process. It supports C(.service), C(.target), C(.socket), C(.mount) and C(.timer) units type. C(.timer) units are supported since community.general 10.5.0. Each name must correspond to the full name of the C(systemd) unit or to a wildcard expression like V('ssh*') and V('*.service'). Wildcard expressions in O(unitname) are supported since community.general 10.5.0.
